title: OpenAI Expects $70 Billion in Annualized Revenue by End of 2026
key_facts: Bloomberg reports, citing people familiar with the matter, that OpenAI expects to reach or exceed $70 billion in annualised revenue by the end of 2026, driven largely by its enterprise business.
OpenAI's annualised revenue was roughly $50 billion at the end of September, the people said.
The company shared the numbers with investors in talks to raise $30 billion or more at a $1.4 trillion valuation before the new money.
The Financial Times reported on Thursday that the earlier $70 billion estimates came from investors using Anthropic's method, which counts cloud-provider sales differently.
Anthropic's annualised revenue hit $65 billion by the end of July, Bloomberg previously reported.
Tech shares led losses in the S&P 500 on Thursday; the Nasdaq 100 fell 1.4% and a gauge of chip giants fell 3.4%.
OpenAI has pushed back IPO plans until at least next year; Anthropic is expected to sell shares as soon as November.
quote_evidence: OpenAI is expecting to reach or exceed $70 billion in annualized revenue by the end of the year, according to people familiar with the matter, driven largely by growth in its enterprise business.
The figure represents a projection of OpenAI's yearly sales based on a shorter period.
why_it_matters_hint: It separates where OpenAI is now (about $50 billion) from where it says it is heading (about $70 billion by year end).
notes: Bloomberg page blocked; Bloomberg text read on Yahoo Finance and a Seeking Alpha summary on TradingView. Anonymous sources; OpenAI has not published the figure.
